exclusions.source_text: Participants with HIV are eligible if they are well-controlled (i.e, an undetectable HIV viral load (\<50 copies/mL) within 6 months of enrollment and a stable ART regimen for at least 6 months prior to enrollment) and at low risk for HIV-related illness

A known malignancy that is progressing or has required active treatment within the past 3 years other than CRPC, which is expected to alter life expectancy or may interfere with CRPC disease assessment
